author: Rosemary Coley
text: I’ve been waiting to find out if the IOS 18.6 had caused any problems on an iPhone XR as I rely on it for my readings.

author: Joanne Parr
text:
Harvey Davis thanks the compatibility chart show the combination will work, it’s an iPhone 12 and latest iOS 
When we start the phone there is no message about compatibility 
We are using the freestylelibre link app which supports Libre 1&2, the only other app available in this country is for libre 3 only (sensors are libre2)
Nothing else has changed, aside from the iOS update
